en-US: Diagrams now offer smoother canvas navigation, clearer multi-selection feedback, refined mind-map and flowchart styling, ten color schemes, and new organization, timeline, and fishbone layouts.
Extensions now use clearer trusted-code and network permissions, host-rendered settings, settings-change notifications, automatic updates for official plugins, and a new official AI RSS plugin.
Android and iOS users can filter notes by tag from the native workspace.
Linux x64 is now available as an AppImage Preview download.
Desktop attachment downloads preserve their original filenames.
Docker self-hosting starts more reliably across supported Linux environments and now packages all runtime dependencies correctly.
zh-CN: 图表现已支持更顺畅的画布导航、更清晰的多选反馈、优化的思维导图与流程图样式、十种配色方案，以及组织架构图、时间线和鱼骨图布局。
扩展现采用更清晰的受信任代码与网络权限、宿主渲染设置和设置变更通知；官方插件可自动更新，并新增官方 AI RSS 插件。
Android 与 iOS 用户现在可以在原生工作区中按标签筛选笔记。
现已提供 Linux x64 AppImage Preview 下载。
桌面端下载附件时会保留原始文件名。
Docker 自托管在受支持的 Linux 环境中启动更可靠，并会正确打包全部运行时依赖。
